recipe_version.title: Brazilian Feijoada with Rice, Garlicky Collards, Farofa, and Orange
recipe_version.description: Brazil's Saturday feast: black beans slowly simmered with smoky bacon, browned pork shoulder, and linguica sausage until thick and inky, served with white rice, quick garlicky collard ribbons, toasty cassava-flour farofa, and fresh orange slices to cut the richness.

ingredients.name: linguica sausage
ingredients.display_name: smoked linguica whose label lists no wheat, milk, or soy
ingredients.note: store-bought; required: the ingredient list shows no wheat, milk, or soy (some brands add fillers or milk powder)

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.preparation: 4 minced for the beans, 3 sliced for the collards, 1 minced for the farofa

ingredients.name: collard greens
ingredients.preparation: stems removed, leaves cut into thin ribbons

ingredients.name: cassava flour
ingredients.display_name: coarse cassava meal (farinha de mandioca, toasted or raw), not fine tapioca-style cassava flour

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/2 tsp beans, 1/2 tsp rice, 1/2 tsp collards and farofa

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Pick over and rinse the beans. Dice the bacon and onion, cube the pork, slice the sausage, and prepare the garlic. Strip and ribbon the collards and slice the oranges.

steps.title: Render and brown
steps.body: Cook the bacon in the Dutch oven over medium-high until the fat renders, 5 minutes. Add the pork in a single layer and sear until browned on two sides, 10 minutes.

steps.title: Aromatics
steps.body: Add the onion and 4 cloves minced garlic and cook until soft, 4 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the beans
steps.body: Add the beans, bay leaves, pepper, and the 10 cups water. Bring to a boil, then cover partly and simmer on low, stirring now and then, until the beans are tender, about 90 minutes. Add 1 1/2 tsp salt once the beans are tender.

steps.title: Add the sausage
steps.body: Add the linguica, mash about 1 cup of beans against the side of the pot to thicken, and simmer uncovered until thick, 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: During that simmer, rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear, bring it to a boil with the 2.25 cups water and 1/2 tsp salt in the saucepan, cover, and cook on low 15 minutes; rest 10 minutes (overlap stated).

steps.title: Cook the collards
steps.body: In the last 10 minutes, heat 2 tbsp olive oil in the 12-inch skillet over medium-high and toss the collards with the sliced garlic and a pinch of salt until bright and just wilted, 3 minutes (overlap stated).

steps.title: Toast the farofa
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in the 10-inch skillet over medium with 1 clove minced garlic, add the cassava flour and a pinch of salt, and stir until golden and sandy, 5 minutes (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Discard the bay leaves. Serve the feijoada with rice, collards, a spoonful of farofa, and orange slices.
